exposure: claims-based algorithms for identifying live birth
claims-based algorithms for identifying fetal death
claims-based algorithms for identifying cesarean section
outcome: accuracy of the end date of pregnancy
cohort: The study included 1757 women who visited the Department of Obstetrics at a university hospital in 2018.
finding: The developed algorithms demonstrated high positive predictive values and accuracy for identifying live birth, fetal death, and cesarean section from administrative data.
